title: Derive signal live|no_signal for sessions in session list and status, document the activity record
action: Per D4 add one pure helper (put it in state_group/sessions.rs, pub(crate)) `fn session_signal(record: &Map, now: DateTime) -> Option<&'static str>`: None when record.status is dead or closed; "no_signal" when record.activity is absent or activity.at is older than 90 s; "live" otherwise. In run_session_list emit a `signal` field on every record in --json (do not persist it) and show it in the text line; in status_full/cells.rs active_workers add `activity` (the recorded object, or null) and `signal` to the projected worker row. Unit tests: 89 s -> live, 91 s -> no_signal, absent -> no_signal, dead -> None. Docs per D2/D4: write docs/knowledge/areas/hook-runtime/agent-activity-record.md describing the activity object fields, the five states, the D3 mapping and sticky rules, the jsonl transition log (last 50), the 90 s read-time signal, and the D5 waiting_on coupling, citing decision ids b17bfa89, 2f782f51, 40c707ba, 2d4e3900, b4f21f29; add a row to the hook-runtime index and to the catalog concept's hook table; run `bee knowledge index` if the repo index is generated, else add the row by hand; finish with `bee knowledge check` green. Commit with trailer `cell: aah-3`.
